latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of neomutt-commander.

- Read, search, organise, and draft emails in terminal using neomutt and w3m.
- Supports listing inbox, reading HTML emails, marking read/unread, managing folders, and archiving messages.
- Compose new emails or replies; outgoing messages are saved as drafts unless sending is explicitly approved.
- Works with multiple IMAP providers (Gmail, Fastmail, Outlook, etc.).
- Includes detailed setup and usage instructions for configuration and navigation.
